definitions.explanation: Substances that are not derived from living organisms and generally do not contain carbon-hydrogen bonds. Includes minerals, metals, water, and salts. The opposite of organic matter (有機物).

examples.japanese: ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{無機物|むきぶつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧だ。
examples.english: Water is one type of inorganic substance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{岩石|がんせき}→岩石：20502_ganseki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{無機物|むきぶつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦できている→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Rocks are made of inorganic matter.

examples.japanese: ⟦{理科|りか}→理科：03994_rika⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{有機物|ゆうきぶつ}→有機物：24274_yuukibutsu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{無機物|むきぶつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{違|ちが}い→違い：03432_chigai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}んだ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
examples.english: I learned the difference between organic and inorganic matter in science class.

notes:
FORMS:
{無機|むき} (inorganic) + ⟦{物|ぶつ}→〜物：28336_butsu⟧ (matter, substance). {無機|むき} is ⟦{無|む}→無：17750_mu⟧ (without) + ⟦{機|き}→〜機：09843_ki⟧ (mechanism/organic), referring to things without the complex structures of living organisms.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{有機物|ゆうきぶつ}→有機物：24274_yuukibutsu⟧: organic matter

SIMILAR COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{無機質|むきしつ}→無機質：19700_mukishitsu⟧: inorganic (also figuratively: cold, impersonal)
- ⟦{鉱物|こうぶつ}→鉱物：04149_koubutsu⟧: mineral

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無機物|むきぶつ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{有機物|ゆうきぶつ}→有機物：24274_yuukibutsu⟧: inorganic and organic matter
- {無機|むき}⟦{化合物|かごうぶつ}→化合物：25020_kagoubutsu⟧: inorganic compound
